content.outro: The ledger stays locked in the chest tonight, and the key stays with you.
content.premise: The counting-room of a wool merchant's house. Its clerk, Tobin Hale, finds a new line at the foot of the ledger every morning, in his own hand, that he did not write.
content.theme: A stone counting-room lit by lanterns: shelves of ledgers either side of a window, a long desk, barrels of stock, a shut iron door.
content.title: The Touched Clerk
